name: citeladder
description: Self-hosted AI search visibility and evidence-grounded growth intelligence. Root manifest: delegates to the pnpm workspace in frontend/ and declares no dependencies of its own.

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm --dir frontend install --frozen-lockfile && node frontend/node_modules/vite-plus/bin/vp config --hooks --no-agent
scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend build && pnpm --dir frontend --filter @citeladder/mcp-app build && node scripts/copy-mcp-app.mjs
